subject: Science
explanation: NGSS is a standards framework, not an examining body: no papers, no guidelines, no certificate. Kept for the same reason as the Common Core folder - the assessment layer exists but belongs to state science assessment programmes, each with its own rights holder and terms.

assessment_is_downstream.note: NGSS-aligned state science assessments are built state-by-state. The NGSS reuse grant does not extend to them; audit each separately.

maintained_by: hand-owned: seeded once by build_us_tree.py and never regenerated.
